title: fix(ui): prevent duplicate bullets in Safari chat lists
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes overlapping bullet dots in chat lists on Safari, including the mobile Web UI.

## User Impact

Unordered lists show one bullet per item. Numbered lists, task checkboxes, nested-list indentation, and chat/thinking text keep their existing presentation. No configuration changes or migrations.

## Why This Change Was Made

Chat draws a custom `::before` bullet but relied on `::marker { content: "" }` to hide the native one. [Safari has incomplete support for styling marker content](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Reference/Selectors/::marker#browser_compatibility). Suppress the native list style on ordinary unordered items instead of relying on that property.

## Evidence

- Final-head CI passed: [run 35667766835](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35667766835), including the enforced `openclaw/ci-gate`, for `bf5e6ad4af1859beb528a417ceb1bac0e4c345a9`. Fresh ClawSweeper review also completed for this head with no findings.

- Removed the 55-line Chromium computed-style test: it pinned the implementation without exercising Safari marker rendering. No permanent tests added for this small CSS repair; the inspected browser and accessibility proof remains applicable because production CSS is unchanged.
- Real mocked Control UI, 400 px/dark and 1180 px/light: captured before/after while emulating Safari's unsupported marker-content behavior with the same `::marker { content: normal }` override in both states. The fix leaves exactly the custom bullet. These are not physical-iPhone captures.
- Native Playwright WebKit and Chromium component checks at both sizes/themes: native unordered markers disabled; ordered markers and accessibility list/listitem structure preserved. The installed Linux WebKit supports marker content, so the original Safari defect needed the explicit compatibility emulation above.
- Changed-file checks passed: UI/test typechecks, formatting, lint/stylelint, i18n, dead-export scans, and repository guards. `git diff --check` passed.
- Fresh AutoReview of the final CSS-only patch and test-removal rationale: scoped-clean through P2 (no actionable P0–P2 findings). CSS formatting, stylelint, and diff whitespace checks passed again.
- Additional existing Markdown-alignment E2E suite could not start: this host's loopback HTTP preflight received proxy HTTP 502. Proxy policy was not changed. Focused browser tests and real-UI captures above completed.

### Mobile visual comparison

Actual mocked Control UI at 400 px, with Safari's unsupported marker-content behavior emulated identically before and after.
